title: Uguhunga kujabuka ikiyaga kidatekanye
intro: Iyumvire uhagaze ku gisenge c’ubwato burengeje urugero igihe imiraba iriko iraduga kandi abakozi bo mu bwato bagatera ubupfindo kugira ngo umuzigo ureke. Igishushanyo kimwe gusa kiratera imbere, cemera iherezo risa n’iherezo, gusa kugira ngo uburebure bube ahantu h’ugusenga no kugaruka. Inyuma hari umuryango wagabishijwe igihano kizoza, imbere hari imbabazi zitari zitezwe.
clues: Narungitswe kuba intumwa ku bantu barenga ibihumbi ijana.
Nasize abantu banje n’ishavu imbere y’uko ngira uruhusha rwo kugenda.
Naciye nsubira mu bwato bwari bufise ibintu vyinshi maze abakozi bo mu bwato baratera ubupfindo kugira ngo bamenye uwuzojugunywa mu kiyaga.
Najugunywe mu kiyaga, n’ifi nini iramira mu gihe nari mfise icaha.
Naninahaje Allah mu mwijima, mmenyesha ko ata yindi mana iriho atari we kandi ko nari mu bacumuzi.
Najugunywe ku nkombe y’ikiyaga, ndwaye, maze Allah atuma igiterwa c’igiti c’umukaraba kimera hejuru yanje, hanyuma abantu banje baravyemera, bahabwa umunezero igihe kanaka.
